rules.promote_to_shadow: BH-FDR q<=0.10 on 2019-2022 AND same sign with p<0.05 on 2023-2026 AND an economic reason
rules.promote_to_live: promotion gate: DSR>=0.95 with N from trial_ledger, positive net of 0.2% in both halves, max drawdown >= -20%, >=60 trading days in shadow/paper
rules.retire: weekly drift status 'broken' 3 weeks in a row, or 'weakening' 8 weeks in a row
rules.trials: every variant tried (new signal, new threshold, new target) adds 1 to its family in trial_ledger.json

asia_gap_nowcast.use: information only: expected opening gap, flags a resting buy that the open would fill or break. Never places or sizes trades.
asia_gap_nowcast.evidence: research/ccj_leadlag.py: N225, KOSPI, Hang Seng, ASX 200 residual closes -> CCJ gap, BH-confirmed; open->close not significant

crypto_weekend_gap.use: information only: Friday-to-Sunday-evening ETH/BTC move as a hint for Monday's gap
crypto_weekend_gap.evidence: ETH confirmed (corr 0.25 -> 0.37), BTC failed discovery FDR; Monday open->close not significant

patient_levels.evidence: research/incumbent_dsr.py after the gap-through-stop fix: test half +24%/yr, Sharpe 1.56, maxDD -11%, DSR 0.67 (N=30) | fuel-chain trio CCJ/LEU/CEG backtest (lab 2.8y): 626 trades, +0.44%/trade, avg 0.267R | 2026-11-20 lineup = 10-stock fuel chain + pulse filter (2y, 3 slots): avg 0.271R, 929 trades
